Maya (Marketing): Quick callout 1: were launching benchmark results + webinar next week. Need a compact social flow: X thread (longform), LinkedIn carousel, and a localized EMEA static. KPI: webinar signups + warm replies for SDRs. Deadline: assets + final copy + shortlink/UTM by Thu EOD.

Sam G: I can schedule X at Mon 10am PT and LinkedIn at 11:30am PT. Prefer X first to seed the thread.

Priya R: Drafting 2 tones: "register now" and "learn-first". Example register: "Real inference numbers. Register for our benchmark deep-dive: https://rwd.in/bw1?utm_source=social&utm_campaign=benchmark_wave1"

Ollie (Design): I'll put together a 5-slide carousel + 3 X cards. Slide 2 = headline chart; slide 4 = cost/latency callouts. Export by Thu 4pm PT.

Ben - Growth: Routing rules: map utm_campaign=benchmark_wave1 clicks/replies to HubSpot. If reply contains /demo|pricing|quote/i or click+forms filled => tag social_lead=warm and send to queue "Bench-Warm". Also post alert to #sales-inbound. I'll DM the webhook to Sam.

Maya (Marketing): Also let's try two auto-replies on X: Reply A = webinar link, Reply B = qualifier ("Reply 'cost' or 'latency' to tell us which matters"). Ben: can we map keywords to intent?

Ben - Growth: Yes. Map 'cost'|'latency' -> prop intent. Prioritize for SDR.

social-bot: Scheduled: X thread (id: 111222333) -> 2026-04-06T17:00:00Z; LinkedIn carousel (id: 111222334) -> 2026-04-06T18:30:00Z; click_webhook=true.
